items.exampleEn: Her persistent questions finally got an answer from the manager.
items.exampleZh: 她鍥而不捨地追問，終於得到經理的答覆。

items.exampleEn: We could hear the engines roar as the plane took off.
items.exampleZh: 飛機起飛時，我們聽得到引擎在轟鳴。

items.exampleEn: A cup of hot coffee revived me after the long drive.
items.exampleZh: 開了很久的車之後，一杯熱咖啡讓我恢復了精神。

items.exampleEn: This popular dance originated in Brazil long ago.
items.exampleZh: 這種受歡迎的舞蹈很久以前起源於巴西。

items.exampleEn: An argument erupted at the meeting over the budget.
items.exampleZh: 會議上因為預算問題爆發了一場爭執。

items.exampleEn: The dog was confined to the yard while we were out.
items.exampleZh: 我們外出時，狗被關在院子裡。

items.exampleEn: The bird used strands of grass to build its home.
items.exampleZh: 那隻鳥用一根根的草築了自己的家。

items.exampleEn: The town saw explosive growth after the train line opened.
items.exampleZh: 火車路線開通後，這座小鎮快速大幅成長。

items.sentenceEn: The crowd roared when the home team scored in the last minute.
items.sentenceZh: 主隊在最後一分鐘得分時，觀眾歡聲雷動。

items.audioEn: This kind of tea originated in the mountains, but now it is grown all over the island.
items.audioZh: 這種茶起源於山區，但現在全島各地都有種植。

items.sentenceEn: The persistent noise from the road kept me awake all night.
items.sentenceZh: 馬路上持續不斷的噪音讓我整晚睡不著。

items.sentenceEn: The volcano last erupted about two hundred years ago.
items.sentenceZh: 這座火山上一次噴發大約是在兩百年前。

items.stemEn: Keep any fire away from this gas, because it is highly ____.
items.stemZh: 這種氣體非常容易爆炸，要讓它遠離任何火源。

items.stemEn: The city plans to ____ the old harbor by opening new shops and cafes there.
items.stemZh: 市政府計畫在舊港口開設新的商店和咖啡館，讓那裡重新熱鬧起來。

items.passageEn: Our city's jazz festival originated in a small cafe more than fifty years ago. This year, persistent rain fell all afternoon, so the first concerts were confined to a large tent by the river, a strange venue for jazz. Many people were cold and tired, but the lively music soon revived everyone. When the famous singer finally appeared, the tent erupted in cheers. Even people walking along the river could hear the crowd roar. After the show, she stayed for an hour to sign photos for her fans.
items.passageZh: 我們城市的爵士音樂節起源於五十多年前的一家小咖啡館。今年下午一直下雨，所以第一批音樂會只能在河邊的一座大帳篷裡舉行，對爵士樂來說是個奇特的場地。很多人又冷又累，但熱鬧的音樂很快讓大家重新振作起來。那位知名歌手終於登場時，帳篷裡爆出一陣歡呼。連在河邊散步的人都聽得到群眾的吼聲。表演結束後，她多留了一個小時替歌迷在照片上簽名。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼第一批音樂會在帳篷裡舉行？
表演結束後歌手做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 請把你的發言限制在五分鐘以內。
referenceEn: Please confine your speech to five minutes.
Please confine your talk to less than five minutes.
rubricZh: 要用 confine A to B（例如 confine your speech to five minutes）

items.promptZh: 我在湯裡發現一根頭髮。
referenceEn: I found a strand of hair in my soup.
There was a strand of hair in my soup.
rubricZh: strand 表示「一縷、一根（細長的東西）」，例如 a strand of hair 等
「發現」可寫，例如 found、there was 等；時態可用過去式或現在完成式

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：FIX 31：「傳統瀕臨消失被復興」與 l03 重複，改成雨中爵士音樂節
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："Our small town has a special tradition that originated more than two hundred years ago. Every autumn, people build a giant paper lion and carry it through the streets while drums roar. For a while, the tradition almost died out, but a group of persistent young people revived it ten years ago. Now visitors come from all over the country, and the whole town has a carnival atmosphere. At the end of the night, the crowd erupts in cheers as fireworks light up the sky."；改後："Our city's jazz festival originated in a small cafe more than fifty years ago. This year, persistent rain fell all afternoon, so the first concerts were confined to a large tent by the river, a strange venue for jazz. Many people were cold and tired, but the lively music soon revived everyone. When the famous singer finally appeared, the tent erupted in cheers. Even people walking along the river could hear the crowd roar. After the show, she stayed for an hour to sign photos for her fans."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：FIX 31：中譯同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："我們小鎮有一項起源於兩百多年前的特別傳統。每年秋天，大家會做一隻巨大的紙獅，在鼓聲轟隆中抬著它穿過大街小巷。這項傳統一度幾乎消失，但十年前一群鍥而不捨的年輕人讓它重新復活。現在全國各地的遊客都會來，整個小鎮充滿嘉年華般的氣氛。夜晚結束時，煙火照亮天空，群眾爆出歡呼聲。"；改後："我們城市的爵士音樂節起源於五十多年前的一家小咖啡館。今年下午一直下雨，所以第一批音樂會只能在河邊的一座大帳篷裡舉行，對爵士樂來說是個奇特的場地。很多人又冷又累，但熱鬧的音樂很快讓大家重新振作起來。那位知名歌手終於登場時，帳篷裡爆出一陣歡呼。連在河邊散步的人都聽得到群眾的吼聲。表演結束後，她多留了一個小時替歌迷在照片上簽名。"
